items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I gave it to Handy because I told him what the use of me having it.

ctx.x: Did you ever play that clarinet piece?

The one he had gave me? Yes it was the Albert system. I played it a good while. I mean I played it a long time. And so finally when I got to the band system. The last piece of Albert system clarinet I had I gave it to Handy. Because he said he tried to play a bam but he couldn't. So he had to do it with a little clarinet with Albert. So I had two pieces of it. Well I gave it to him. I couldn't find the rest of it. I gave it to Handy because I told him what the use of me having it. I don't think I'll be playing an…

I don't remember that he ever told me that. I heard he didn't but I went back to the Albert. Piku told me once that he had learned a little bit on the bam but never did play it much I don't think. I think one time he could play both of them.
